name: talon-onchain-equities
description: Autonomous risk management, unbundling, and 1:1 invariant arbitrage for Coinbase tokenized stocks on Base mainnet.
author: Talon Protocol

tools.name: talon_get_status
tools.description: Get current risk metrics, B20 multiplier, and parity status for a tokenized Coinbase equity (e.g., AAPLc, NVDAc, TSLAc) on Base.

tools.name: talon_activate_earnings_shield
tools.description: Autonomously splits tokenized stock into clip (multiplier) and talon (price) before an earnings volatility shock, hedging the price leg into USDC to protect capital.

amount.description: Amount of stock to unbundle and shield (e.g. '1.0')

maxDrawdownPercent.description: Maximum tolerated price drawdown before hedging price leg

tools.name: talon_recombine_stock
tools.description: Recombines equal amounts of clip and talon tokens back into the underlying Coinbase tokenized stock 1:1 via TalonVault.join().

amount.description: Raw token amount of pairs to burn and redeem

tools.name: talon_check_parity
tools.description: Audits the mathematical 1:1 invariant on Base mainnet (1 Underlying Stock = 1 clipToken + 1 talonToken) and detects arbitrage opportunities.

symbol.description: Stock symbol to check parity for
